reviews.title: The Definition of $1 Worth of Support
reviews.text:
I have never experienced such unhelpful customer support. ( if there was even one) Despite contacting Jodel support repeatedly through the app chat and via email , explaining that I cannot post new Jodels or comment, and following all the troubleshooting steps, my account still does not work.

Instead of investigating the actual problem, I keep receiving generic auto replies about using the latest version (which I was).

I am paying for a subscription, I cannot use, and the so called support team seems more interested in sending standard responses and closing chats than resolving the issue.

You would  expect a proper investigation, a clear explanation, and a real solution—not endless copy-and-paste replies.

The automod is extremely aggressive and moves nearly everything to AfterDark for no explainable nor deterministic reason. The same post, posted twice may not be flagged. Please lower the temperature on the automod LLM or add a way to give feedback on those auto modded posts to help train it properly. Half baked feature that is killing the user existence (don’t get me started on the ads)
